controls.neural: Same architecture, initialization, AdamW settings, update count, batch indices, validation schedule; only one recorded deranged training correspondence changes. Reverse uses the same (x,y_perm) pairs.
controls.affine: Validation-selected raw affine ridge; descriptive comparator, not compute matched.

synthetic.distribution: planted nonlinear four-factor paired views; independently drawn samples, not held-out theorem structures
synthetic.acceptance: Finite held-out metrics; paired normalized RMSE below shuffled and mean in both directions; reload reproduces predictions. Failure is reported, not tuned away.

actual_vectors.acceptance: Audit succeeds, neural control budgets match, finite metrics and reload consistency. No performance improvement required. No large-model collection/inference.

loop.acceptance: Two complete iterations, real Lean admission, five matched recipient arms, fresh pre-update bridge each iteration, persistent recipient optimizer state, independent verifier succeeds and tampered target is rejected. Capability improvement not required.

selection: Train normalization only; validation checkpoint selection on fixed schedule; test and independent capability benchmark never tune translator.
